scope: Only the two additional synthetic same-contract flat-baseline controls; the source fixture and every recorded model result remain immutable.
rationale: News pressure direction is not a calibrated settlement-price magnitude. A 40 mcm/d flow change does not alone identify a move beyond the ±0.30 EUR/MWh flat band.
A conditionally slightly lower or higher close may remain in the flat band. Requiring the close class to copy the news sign was stronger than the supplied evidence.
Both controls are amended symmetrically. News mechanism sign remains strict; a supported conditional close forecast may have the same directional family or flat.
This amendment does not establish actual forecast accuracy, a price elasticity, or any movement magnitude.
unchanged_requirements: Source facts, as-of boundaries, supply/demand mechanism checks, citations, and no invented announcement price reaction or priced-in attribution remain mandatory.
The original expectation check, record.contract_passed, raw answers, failed attempts, and latest-stage failure selection remain visible.
No-result, request failure, null/insufficient close, unsupported opposite direction, or semantically invalid prose cannot pass merely through this amendment.
Earlier fabricated post-announcement reaction and missing-data-as-neutral errors remain failures; a later logically consistent flat forecast does not relabel those records.
